rows.note: Use 痛 as the all-purpose verb for saying that a body part or injury is painful.

example.english: I feel my foot hurt when I walk.
example.jyutping: ngo5 haang4 lou6 go2 zan6 zek3 goek3 wui5 tung3

rows.note: Use 整傷 when someone causes physical injury or pain, especially in an everyday spoken context.

example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 zing2 soeng1 zi6 gei2 aa3

rows.note: Use 傷害 for causing serious physical or emotional harm, especially in more formal wording.

example.english: These remarks hurt many citizens' feelings.
example.traditional: 呢啲言論傷害咗好多市民嘅感情。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 jin4 leon6 soeng1 hoi6 zo2 hou2 do1 si5 man4 ge3 gam2 cing4
